title: The Sixth Book
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: Metals and stones: subliming quicksilver, making cinnabar, borax and aqua fortis; casting medals in moulds of six kinds of earth; gilding iron, copper and silver; counterfeiting diamonds, rubies and emeralds; and calcining silver and talc.
